baseline_findings.title: Missing authentication for login verification endpoint
baseline_findings.description: The /login/verify/:token route does not require any form of authentication or authorization. Any user can access this endpoint and attempt to verify their email by providing a valid token.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check is present in the function or its callers, allowing any user to access the login verification endpoint without proper authentication. The route should require authentication to ensure that only authorized users can verify their email addresses.
